label: eq:localeuler

detail: Range and rank calculations in the product case. General comparison sequence is external.

detail: Residue-degree weighted divisor map.

label: eq:sunitseq
detail: Lifting inside the kernel of the norm once the absolute norm diagram is available.

detail: Comparison with logarithm-weighted finite valuation rows.

detail: Dedekind zeta factorization for relative norm tori.

label: eq:invrelative
detail: Mixed finite-factor correction, formal order and product coefficient.

label: eq:invrelativelead
detail: Formal product at the expected order with zeta constant and residue ratio supplied.

label: eq:absaug
detail: Absolute augmentation by the trace-one column.

label: eq:arbitrary-leading
detail: Rank bound, removal of t powers of the variable and the leading coefficient of a product.

label: eq:splitprojection
detail: Surjectivity and equality of kernels at equal finite dimension.

label: eq:relplog
detail: Logarithms of relative units in the local trace-zero subspace.

label: eq:relativepadicvalue
detail: Normalization of a relative residue. Colmez’s formula is an external arithmetic input.

label: eq:padicS
detail: Finite product and powers of lower-bounded Taylor factors.

detail: Definition of the reduced branch in the paper; cancellation of powers in Lean.

detail: Negative norm logarithm in the chosen branch.

label: eq:RN
detail: Branch translation and valuation normalization for actual matrices.

detail: Affine isolation from injectivity and disjointness of the logarithm image.

detail: Order of the inverse factors and compatibility under basis change.

detail: Order of cup factors and sign of local reciprocity.

label: eq:liftgraph
detail: Obstruction equals zero exactly on the negative transpose graph.

label: eq:principal-cup
detail: All principal minors and their signs over arbitrary commutative rings.

label: eq:decomp
detail: Decomposition of the odd permutation module and its commutant.

label: eq:blockpoly
detail: The full characteristic-polynomial product for different block dimensions and arbitrary multiplicities. The representation-theoretic decomposition supplies the blocks.

detail: Dimension of the algebraic span of actual simultaneous entries.

detail: Artin L-value and the local complex Euler slopes.

detail: Normalization of a Taylor coefficient, including when the coefficient is zero.

detail: Linear trace-multiplicity equations under affine independence.

detail: Explicit Artin functional equation and archimedean gamma factors.

detail: Squarefree Euler coefficients at specified unramified primes.

label: eq:clearedgerms
detail: A nonzero solution to any family of algebraic sample equations descends to the base field.

label: eq:frequency
detail: A normalized isolated polynomial with vanishing tail is zero; all weights at a scale vanish under the formal sample hypotheses.

label: eq:allartinleading
detail: Formal coefficient extraction and multiplicative cancellation. Brauer and analytic identification remain external.

label: eq:s3coeff
detail: Actual permutation character table, algebraic coefficient identity and unscaled factor of two.

detail: Exact sequence of 1-motives with abelian quotient. The diagonal determinant identity is checked.
